# playwhaly.com

playwhaly.com is 威利 Whaly's public gaming site. It is a calm place for videos, limited time free games from official stores, and a public game list. The tone is casual and unhurried. 各種遊戲都玩，輕鬆玩、慢慢聊，一起來放鬆～

## Pages

- /  Home, with the latest video, a short intro, destination cards, recent videos, and social links
- /free  Limited time free games, plus a collapsed list of free in-game items and DLC. Claim links go only to official stores or official game sites
- /backlog  The public game list, with search and filters
- /tier  Whaly's own yearly game tiers (S to D), with short reviews and links to his videos
- /spin  A wheel that picks one unplayed game
- /terms  Terms of Service
- /privacy  Privacy Policy

Contact: hi@playwhaly.com
